name: call-to-action-18
description: Four audience cards for startups, agencies, enterprise and education, each with its own link CTA.

files.content:
import { ArrowUpRight, Briefcase, Building2, GraduationCap, Rocket, } from "@designali/icons" const audiences = [ { icon: Rocket, title: "Startups", body: "A brand identity, UI design and Next.js site delivered as one sprint.", cta: "Start a project", }, { icon: Briefcase, title: "Agencies", body: "White-label design, CGI, motion and front-end builds under your name.", cta: "Partner with Designali", }, { icon: Building2, title: "Product teams", body: "Design systems, UI/UX and creative development alongside your team.", cta: "Talk to Ali", }, { icon: GraduationCap, title: "Education", body: "Free Designali templates, blocks and icons for students and teachers.", cta: "Get student access", }, ] export default function CallToAction18() { return (

Pick the path that fits your team.

Same studio, tailored terms. Choose where you are today and we will set you up accordingly.

{audiences.map(({ icon: Icon, title, body, cta }) => (

{title}

{body}

{cta} ))}
) }
